The vineyard and winery are named in honor of Tom Bombadil and after the river that flowed past his house. In the spirit of Tom we strive to and excel in using only the most natural and sustainable methods in bringing you the tastiest vintages inspired by Iarwain Ben-adar himself. We specialize in red, white, and rosé wines.

Keep the reference’s oversized serif type, small sans-serif labels, generous whitespace, asymmetrical layouts, and simple UI. Create a palette of warm neutrals, earthy greens, and deep wine tones.

Keep the photography large and the page spacious, mixing big visual moments with quieter sections. Motion should stay subtle and easy.
